meta.title: SHOVKANA — hand-painted silk scarves
meta.description: A workshop of silk scarves. Natural silk, painted by hand, delivered in Ukraine and to France.

home.bar: Natural silk · Painted by hand · Ukraine and France
home.title: Silk, painted by hand
home.lead: Every SHOVKANA scarf is natural silk and the artist’s brush. A design can return in another size, yet each piece stays its own work.
home.step1: The artist takes the brush across the silk. A sketch sets the direction, and the work may leave it behind.
home.step2: The dye is set with steam, then the silk is washed. A mistake at this stage cannot be undone.
home.step3: The edge is hemmed by hand. The scarf is ready for the neck, the hair, the shoulders or a bag.
home.step4: Each scarf is packed so that opening it feels good — for yourself, or as a gift.
home.noteTitle: A repeat is not a copy
home.note: A design can be ordered in another size. Even then the painting differs a little: it is a brush, not a print.

about.title: The workshop
about.lead: SHOVKANA is a workshop of silk accessories. Every scarf is painted by the artist.
about.artistText: The workshop’s artist paints each scarf. The process and the works are on her Instagram.
about.repeat: A design exists in more than one size. When it is painted again, the sketch stays, but the brush makes a slightly different scarf. On the product page, the price follows the size you choose.
about.where: The scarves can be tried on at the Vsi. Svoi and Kurazh Bazar markets, ordered through Instagram, or bought here — with delivery in Ukraine and to France.
about.twilly: The workshop also makes twillies. This catalogue holds the scarves from recent posts, with a size and a price. Twillies will be added as their own pieces once there are photographs and prices.

care.title: Care
care.lead: This is how hand-painted natural silk is looked after. If a particular scarf’s label says otherwise, follow the label.
care.wash: Hand wash in cool water, up to 30 °C, with a drop of mild soap. Do not rub or wring. Dry cleaning is fine.
care.dry: Dry in the shade, smoothed out or hanging. Direct sun fades both the silk and the dye.
care.iron: A barely warm iron, on the silk setting, from the reverse. Slightly damp silk irons more kindly.
care.keep: Fold it, do not leave it knotted for long, and keep it away from sun and heat.

deliveryPage.title: Delivery and payment
deliveryPage.ua: Nova Poshta, to a branch or by courier. The recipient pays the carrier’s tariff. It is not added to the scarf’s price.
deliveryPage.fr: Delivery to an address. {price} is added to the order. This is the workshop’s flat fee for sending a light scarf. Before the first real payment, match it to the current Ukrposhta or Nova Poshta tariff.
deliveryPage.pay: Visa or Mastercard, Apple Pay and Google Pay through monobank acquiring. The money arrives in the Ukrainian sole trader’s account in hryvnia, even when the card is French.

offer.title: Terms of sale
offer.sellerPending: a sole trader registered in Ukraine. The full name and tax number will be published here before payments are accepted
offer.goods: The goods are hand-painted scarves in natural silk. The colour on a screen can differ a little from the silk itself. A design repeated in another size is still painted by hand, so the pieces are not exact copies of each other.
offer.payment: Prices on the site are in hryvnia. Payment is by card through monobank acquiring. Funds are credited to the sole trader’s account in hryvnia. A foreign card’s bank may apply its own conversion and fee.
offer.delivery: Delivery in Ukraine is by Nova Poshta, to a branch or by courier, at the carrier’s tariff, paid by the recipient. Delivery to France is to a postal address. The cost is shown on the delivery page and included in the invoice.
offer.returns: Returns are accepted within 14 days if the scarf has not been worn, its appearance is intact and the hem is undamaged. The buyer pays the return postage. Changes made at the buyer’s request cannot be returned.
offer.data: Name, phone, email and address are used only to pack and send the order and to write about it.

footer.pay: Card payment through monobank. Settlement is in hryvnia to the sole trader’s account.
